_doc: Hardcoded FALLBACK thresholds. These are used only when the backend has never sent 'config' in the /sensors/telemetry response, or when a specific field in 'config' is null. Once the backend sends a valid config value for a field, that remote value is used. See config/threshold_resolver.py. This JSON shape is intentionally identical to the API 'config' shape so fallback works per field, not all-or-nothing.
_soilMoistureDangerThreshold_note: Soil moisture percentage. Values below this threshold mean dry/dangerous conditions using lower_is_worse evaluation.
_waterDangerThreshold_note: Water level in meters in the tank/reservoir. Values below this threshold mean the water level is low using lower_is_worse evaluation. Some API responses send null for this field; when that happens, this local value is used.

alarm._note: The local siren relay turns on only after N consecutive readings cross a danger threshold. This is independent from emergency uploads to the backend.
